title: IEEE VIS Publications: Growth, Venue Mix, and the Journal Turn

takeaway: The panels converge on one conclusion: IEEE VIS changed less by simple expansion than by rebalancing into a journal-centered publication record, with Vis remaining the largest venue grouping and collaboration/metadata measures maturing by 2024. What follows is practical: read any long-run VIS trend through paper type and venue mix before attributing it to overall community growth. The conclusion would change if later years returned to a conference-paper majority or if the 2024 journal-only endpoint proved to be a normalization artifact.
